title: SimpleMessages
body:
# Introduction

Simple messages allows you to manage the default messages, that players can send to each other. It adds a better configurable messages. You can edit almost everything and I am open for feedback!

# Features

- Easy config with a lot of features
- Permission specific commands
- 1.21+ support
- Custom Placeholders & Chat Colors


# Placeholders

* `%player_sender%` → Sender username
* `%player_receiver%` → Receiver username
* `%message%` → The sent message
* `%player%` → Generic player placeholder

# Commands

| Command                   | Description              |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| `/msg <player> <message>` | Send a private message   |
| `/reply <message>`        | Reply to the last player |
| `/r <message>`            | Alias for `/reply`       |
| `/ignore <player>`        | Ignore/unignore a player |

# Permissions

| Permission              | Description               |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------- |
| `simplemessages.msg`    | Allows usage of `/msg`    |
| `simplemessages.reply`  | Allows usage of `/reply`  |
| `simplemessages.ignore` | Allows usage of `/ignore` |

All permissions are enabled by default.
